summary: Quanome Technologies filed an 8-K on October 5, 2026, reporting two ordinary commercial contracts dated September 29, 2026. The company entered Purchase Agreement No. 2 with Compal Electronics for 32 GPU server units at roughly $18.8 million, with 20% due on order acknowledgment and 80% before shipment. Separately, subsidiary XDT Infrastructure signed a 60-month Token Factory Master Services Agreement with XPERT SOFTWARE SOLUTIONS PTE. LTD. for AI inference capacity, carrying about $100.9 million in committed fees. Neither is a special situation; watch delivery, payment, and counterparty performance risk.
